skills_considered.reason: The discovery ledger is a research surface owned by other batches; the corrections this reading supports are proposed as commit candidates rather than edited in place.
A transferable lesson from another gene is not a therapeutic hypothesis for WWOX; forging one here would convert a stated transfer limit into a lead.
No small molecule with a SMILES is proposed as an intervention, so there is nothing for the BLOCK-1 ADMET gate to triage.
Scientists do not touch the four current files; every change is proposed as a commit candidate for a later BATCH_COMMIT.
The triples are published in the candidates for a blind auditor; the reader of a paper cannot audit their own locators.

entries.proposition: The proband, homozygous for both missense alleles, had no WWOX-related neurological disease.
entries.snippet: the cancer patient harboring germline homozygous WWOX P252A and P282A variants did not suffer from WWOX‐related nervous system disease

entries.proposition: Chaperone-mediated autophagy is the authors' speculation, not their finding.
entries.snippet: we speculated that lysosomal degradation of WWOX252A mutant protein occurred through chaperone‐mediated autophagy

entries.proposition: Abundance and function are confounded for P252A and the paper says so.
entries.snippet: likely due to the low abundance of the unstable WWOXP252A mutant

entries.proposition: The authors allow residual function rather than a complete null.
entries.snippet: may have some residual protein function to maintain the development of the neurological system

entries.proposition: No nucleotide-excision-repair assay supports the POLE4 claim.
entries.snippet: the functional relevance of WWOX‐POLE4 interaction in nucleotide excision repair remains to be elucidated

entries.proposition: The paper's own domain schematic places P252A inside the SDR and P282A outside it.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 1D, lower panel: a 414-residue protein bar with two diamond 'WW' boxes at ticks 16-49 and 57-90 and a box labelled 'SDR' spanning ticks 125-262; the labelled P252A tick falls inside the SDR box and the labelled P282A tick falls to the right of its 262 boundary.

entries.proposition: Both alleles are common in gnomAD and P282A is called tolerated by two of the paper's own predictors.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] (a table published only as a rendered page in the supplementary document) Supplementary Table 4 'WWOX germline variants detected in the patient': row 1 WWOX NM_016373 c.754C>G P252A, SIFT Deleterious, MutationTaster Disease causing, gnomAD allele frequency 0.0063, Genotype Homo; row 2 WWOX NM_016373 c.844C>G P282A, SIFT Tolerated, MutationTaster 'Polymorphism automatic', gnomAD allele frequency 0.0733, Genotype Homo.

entries.proposition: This paper contains no enzymatic assay of any kind: the oxidoreductase function of the SDR fold is never measured, for either allele.
entries.snippet: The gene encoding WWOX (WW domain‐containing oxidoreductase), spanning chromosome region 16q23.1‐16q23.2 and crossing 1.1 million base pairs, ranks among the largest genes in the human genome.
entries.anchor: Introduction, opening sentence - the only occurrence of the word oxidoreductase in the article; SDR, enzyme, enzymatic, catalytic, dehydrogenase and short-chain occur zero times

entries.proposition: The four compared lines are not expression-matched: the P252A band is faint in both cell lines and the P282A band is visibly weaker than wild type in BCPAP, with an even GAPDH row.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 2A shows two Flag-WWOX blots over a GAPDH loading row. In CAL-62 the Flag-WWOX band is strong for WWOX-WT, faint for WWOX-P252A and strong for WWOX-P282A; in BCPAP the WWOX-WT band is the strongest of the blot, WWOX-P252A is very faint and WWOX-P282A is visibly weaker than WWOX-WT, while the four GAPDH bands are even in both blots. The paper publishes no densitometry for this blot.
entries.anchor: Figure 2, panel A; native JPEG inspected, and the panel re-cropped and magnified twofold

entries.proposition: The three transgenic lines are not transcript-matched either, and the cycloheximide chase measures decay rate rather than steady-state abundance per transcript.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 4A plots relative WWOX mRNA expression in CAL-62 at approximately 0 for the empty vector, 72 for WWOX-WT, 78 for WWOX-P252A and 108 for WWOX-P282A, each marked **** against the vector. Figure 4B plots relative WWOX protein level over a ten-hour cycloheximide chase: WWOX-P252A falls to about 0.3 of its own time zero and is marked *, **, ***, ** and * at 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 hours, while WWOX-P282A tracks WWOX-WT and is marked ns at every timepoint.
entries.anchor: Figure 4, panels A and B; native JPEG inspected and the top third re-cropped and magnified

entries.proposition: The interactome supplement behind the POLE4 argument is a presence-only list with no replicate, no fold change and no statistic.
entries.snippet: [spreadsheet attestation - read cell-wise from the workbook XML] Sheet 'list' of Supplementary Table 6 holds 261 protein rows under the columns Uniprot_ID, Gene_name, Description, CAL-62_WT_IgG, CAL-62_WT_Anti-Flag, CAL-62_pCMV-3Tag_IgG and CAL-62_pCMV-3Tag_Anti-Flag. Every one of the 261 rows carries the string 'Lost Detection' in all three control columns and a single numeric intensity in CAL-62_WT_Anti-Flag; no column holds a fold change, a p value or an FDR, and WWOX itself is not a row. POLE4 is rank 52 of 261 by intensity at 1937463.375.
entries.anchor: Supplementary Table 6, sheet 'list', all 261 data rows; read cell-wise from the workbook XML

entries.proposition: A WWOX pull-down in this thyroid carcinoma line recovers DVL2, which touches the WWOX-Dishevelled axis without measuring it.
entries.snippet: [spreadsheet attestation - read cell-wise from the workbook XML] Supplementary Table 6 row O14641 DVL2 'Segment polarity protein dishevelled homolog DVL-2' carries 'Lost Detection' in CAL-62_WT_IgG, CAL-62_pCMV-3Tag_IgG and CAL-62_pCMV-3Tag_Anti-Flag and the intensity 375599.84375 in CAL-62_WT_Anti-Flag, which is rank 190 of the 261 rows. HSPA8, LAMP2, POLE3, POLD2 and TP53 are absent from the list.
entries.anchor: Supplementary Table 6, sheet 'list', row DVL2; read cell-wise from the workbook XML
